تقاطرت (form VI)
# تَقَاطَرْتُ (taqāṭartu) /ta.qaː.tˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
# تَقَاطَرْتَ (taqāṭarta) /ta.qaː.tˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
# تَقَاطَرْتِ (taqāṭarti) /ta.qaː.tˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
# تَقَاطَرَتْ (taqāṭarat) /ta.qaː.tˤa.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
